purpose: Prioritize the next SolQvia real-device captures without fabricating fresh GSC demand, device availability, or runtime results.

data_state.consequence: GSC is used only where a query cluster is explicitly supported by Phase145/153. Device-specific priorities are evidence-gap/operational priorities, not search-demand rankings.

tracks.rule: Only campaigns with directly supported GSC query intent are listed here.

campaigns.device_requirement: Any exact-model au eSIM-capable device legitimately available for testing; exact model must be recorded before execution.
campaigns.value: Validate the post-activation sequence beyond the restart message: profile enablement, carrier line activation, service registration, data, voice, SMS, and optional au Mail/MMS where applicable.
campaigns.evidence_boundary: The published SMS/restart instruction is not proof that any downstream function works.
campaigns.execution_gate: Do not execute until an exact device, software snapshot, test line, and consent-safe voice/SMS counterpart are available.

tracks.rule: Prefer continuing an existing SolQvia capture when one additional observation can unlock multiple downstream diagnostic layers.

campaigns.uniqueness_reason: Existing SolQvia-owned exact-model cross-carrier eSIM evidence can be extended instead of starting from zero.
campaigns.execution_gate: Requires the same exact model and a valid Y!mobile test line. Do not infer continuity with the 2026-08-08 capture unless the current software snapshot is recorded.

campaigns.uniqueness_reason: Second cross-carrier branch on the same exact device can separate Y!mobile and SoftBank behavior rather than merging them.
campaigns.execution_gate: Requires the same exact model and a valid SoftBank test line. No downstream result from Y!mobile may be copied across.

global_rules: A planned campaign is not real-device evidence.
No planned result is written into Phase162 real-device captures until an actual test is performed.
Fresh GSC data must replace the dated 2026-09-08 seed before any new device-specific search-demand ranking is claimed.
Exact model, carrier, SIM type, software snapshot and test date are mandatory at execution time.
Y!mobile, SoftBank, au, docomo and Rakuten results are separate evidence scopes.
No test may require emergency calling, forced service-menu radio changes, eSIM deletion/reissue, or factory/network reset as a routine step.
Voice/SMS tests use only consent-safe test counterparts and never store phone numbers.
